D1_audience_size.rule: Count of 1-20-person business units (A02 employer proxy + A03 nonemployers at base receipts floor A01). >=300k:5; 150-300k:4; 75-150k:3; 30-75k:2; <30k:1

D2_estimate_intensity.rule: How often the owner must produce a written, priced estimate and how many bids it takes to win

D3_job_complexity_fit.rule: Multi-line estimates mixing materials, labor, measurements, options and change orders score high; single-price flat-rate jobs score low

D4_owner_purchase_authority.rule: Share of the segment's employer establishments with <20 paid employees (CBP 2023). >=95%:5; 90-95%:4; 80-90%:3; 70-80%:2; <70%:1

D5_software_readiness.rule: Willingness to pay and current tech use (Software Advice budgets, Jobber AI adoption by trade)

D6_digital_reachability.rule: Reachable through low-cost digital channels (Facebook groups, YouTube, search) given Pew and Jobber channel data

D7_competitive_whitespace.rule: 5 = few trade-specific estimating tools; 1 = crowded with entrenched vertical software
